patch_description: This rewrite keeps the fixed training/data/measurement pipeline unchanged and only improves the candidate ANSATZ_SPEC. It crossovers from the best-performing idea that uses heavy parameter sharing to drastically cut learnable parameters per block (targeting the prior “good” ~74 total parameters). Concretely: - Uses 4 shared parameters for the initial RY layer (pairs (0,1),(2,3),(4,5),(6,7)). - Uses 4 shared parameters for a pre-RZ layer (same pairing pattern). - Uses an entangling CZ layer on two interleaved rings (like the good candidate) plus additional fixed “chord” CZ couplings (0-4,1-5,2-6,3-7) to increase expressivity without adding parameters. - Uses 4 shared parameters for a final post-RZ layer (same pairing pattern). No parametrized controlled rotations are added (they would increase parameter count and harmed performance in the current program).
